    <title>
        Docutils Web Site
    <decoration>
        <header>
            <paragraph>
                <reference anonymous="1" name="Docutils" refuri="https://docutils.sourceforge.io">
                    Docutils
                 | 
                <reference anonymous="1" name="Overview" refuri="../index.html">
                    Overview

                <reference anonymous="1" name="Developers" refuri="../index.html#howto">
                    Developers
            <target anonymous="1" ids="target-1" refuri="https://docutils.sourceforge.io">
            <target anonymous="1" ids="target-2" refuri="../index.html">
            <target anonymous="1" ids="target-3" refuri="../index.html#project-fundamentals">
            <target anonymous="1" ids="target-4" refuri="../index.html#user">
            <target anonymous="1" ids="target-5" refuri="../index.html#ref">
            <target anonymous="1" ids="target-6" refuri="../index.html#howto">
    <docinfo>
        <author>
            David Goodger; open to all Docutils developers
        <contact>
            <reference refuri="mailto:docutils-develop@lists.sourceforge.net">
                docutils-develop@lists.sourceforge.net
        <date>
            2025-03-07
        <revision>
            10020
        <copyright>
            This document has been placed in the public domain.
    <comment xml:space="preserve">
        Minimal menu bar for inclusion in documentation sources
        in ``docutils/docs/*/`` sub-diretories.
        
        Attention: this is not a standalone document.
    <paragraph>
        The Docutils web site, <
        <reference refuri="https://docutils.sourceforge.io/">
            https://docutils.sourceforge.io/
        >, is
        maintained by the 
        <literal>
            docutils-update.local
         script, run by project
        maintainers on their local machines.  The script
        will process any .rst/.txt file which is newer than the corresponding .html
        file in the local copy of the project's web directory and upload the changes
        to the web site at SourceForge.
    <paragraph>
        Please 
        <strong>
            do not
         add any generated .html files to the Docutils
        repository.  They will be generated automatically after a one-time
        setup (
        <reference anonymous="1" name="described below" refid="adding-rst-txt-files">
            described below
        ).
    <target anonymous="1" ids="target-7" refid="adding-rst-txt-files">
    <paragraph>
        The 
        <reference anonymous="1" name="docutils-update.local" refuri="https://docutils.sourceforge.io/sandbox/infrastructure/docutils-update.local">
            docutils-update.local
         script is located at
        <literal>
            sandbox/infrastructure/docutils-update.local
        .
    <target anonymous="1" ids="target-8" refuri="https://docutils.sourceforge.io/sandbox/infrastructure/docutils-update.local">
    <section ids="setting-up" names="setting\ up">
        <title>
            Setting Up
        <paragraph>
            (TBA)
        <hint>
            <paragraph>
                Anyone with checkin privileges can be a web-site maintainer. You need to
                set up the directories for a local website build.
            <paragraph>
                The procedure for that was on the docutils-devel list a while ago.
    <section ids="adding-rst-txt-files" names="adding\ .rst/.txt\ files">
        <title>
            Adding .rst/.txt Files
        <section ids="user-contributor" names="user/contributor">
            <title>
                User/Contributor
            <paragraph>
                When adding a new .rst/.txt file that should be converted to HTML:
            <enumerated_list enumtype="arabic" prefix="" suffix=".">
                <list_item>
                    <paragraph>
                        Edit sandbox/infrastructure/htmlfiles.lst, and add the .html file
                        corresponding to the new .rst/.txt file (please keep the sorted order).
                <list_item>
                    <paragraph>
                        Commit the edited version to the SVN repository.
        <section ids="maintainer" names="maintainer">
            <title>
                Maintainer
            <enumerated_list enumtype="arabic" prefix="" suffix=".">
                <list_item>
                    <paragraph>
                        If there are new directories in the SVN, allow the update script to run
                        once to create the directories in the filesystem before preparing for
                        HTML processing.
                <list_item>
                    <paragraph>
                        Any .html document with a corresponding .rst/.txt file is regenerated
                        if the .rst/.txt has changed, but no new .html files will be generated.
                    <paragraph>
                        Therefore 
                        <emphasis>
                            touch
                         the .html-file and then the .rst/.txt.
                <list_item>
                    <paragraph>
                        <literal>
                            docutils-update.local -u
                            Regenerate .html unconditionally.
    <section ids="removing-files-directories" names="removing\ files\ &\ directories">
        <title>
            Removing Files & Directories
        <enumerated_list enumtype="arabic" prefix="" suffix=".">
            <list_item>
                <paragraph>
                    Remove from SVN
            <list_item>
                <paragraph>
                    Remove to-be-generated HTML files from
                    <literal>
                        sandbox/infrastructure/htmlfiles.lst
                    .
            <list_item>
                <paragraph>
                    Removing files and directories from SVN will not trigger their removal
                    from the web site.  Files and directories must be manually removed from
                    sourceforge.net (under 
                    <literal>
                        /home/project-web/docutils/htdocs/
                    ).
        <comment xml:space="preserve">
            Emacs settings
            
            Local Variables:
            mode: indented-text
            mode: rst
            indent-tabs-mode: nil
            sentence-end-double-space: t
            fill-column: 70
            End:
